scope: Full read-only validation of resume lane content before operation startup.
finding: The lightweight preflight accepted a journal with matching identity/roster even when routes, state rows, entries, buddy targets or request ages would fail the shared ADOPT validator after startup had consumed the durable order.
implementation: Add CHECK mode to the existing shared validator. It requires exact expectedSnapshot, owner/epoch/generation, visit context, building transform and original hard deadline, then runs the same full bounded content checks as ADOPT. It exits before job mutation or publication; only SAVE/ADOPT require an already-started exact operation.
Move the existing sixteen-exit discovery/sort earlier and reuse it for CHECK and later preparation. No second exit scan, payload-schema change, native command, new worker or deadline renewal.

Resume supplies original cleared/unreachable progress, positions, pair roster and current native exit inventory. Invalid content defers read-only; the prior commit-boundary journal equality check remains.
cost: One extra bounded full validation on entry/sweep resume; existing 8-lane, 2-actor/lane and 512-node limits remain. Pending malformed data can repeat validation through existing discovery retries under original deadlines. No extra per-frame job or world query count on normal admission. Cost not measured.

validation.earlierBuild: attempt1 passed before explicit expectedSnapshot binding; its candidate remains historical, not final evidence.

limits: No complete ordered journal replay/owner-ready transport, stale-owner quiescence or actual actor-native acknowledgement. Subsequent preparation/adoption can still fail if authority or geometry changes. Physical CQB flow, normal/HC/JIP and performance budget unverified. Audits paused; whole goal incomplete; no percentage increase.
